versions.changelog:
Initial release of the lrshuAI-text-to-speech skill:

- Converts input text to natural-sounding speech.
- Supports three TTS models: Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS, Doubao TTS, and Keling TTS.
- Usage requires running with the native python command, not openclaw run.
- Requires TEAM_API_KEY environment variable for operation.
